PORT.description: Health endpoint port. Must stay 8080 — it matches the Railway domain target port configured in this template.

CONFIG_PASSWORD.description: Password for Hummingbot's encrypted keystore (stores connector API keys). Auto-generated per deployment. Set your own to keep keys readable across redeploys.

SCRIPT_CONFIG.description: Strategy config file to run from conf/scripts/ on the volume. Seeded on first boot with a pure market-making sample strategy.

HBOT_EXCHANGE.description: Connector id. Paper-trade connectors simulate fills with no API keys. Switch to a live connector (e.g. kraken) after adding API keys via the keystore.

HBOT_TRADING_PAIR.description: Market to make, in BASE-QUOTE format (e.g. ETH-USD, BTC-USDT).

HBOT_BID_SPREAD.description: Distance of buy orders below the mid price, in percent.

HBOT_ASK_SPREAD.description: Distance of sell orders above the mid price, in percent.

HBOT_PRICE_TYPE.description: Reference price for spreads: mid, last, best_bid, or best_ask.
